scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy:prod
scripts.deploy:prod: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -c wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run db:reset:preview && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env preview -c wrangler.jsonc && wrangler versions upload --env preview -c wrangler.jsonc --tag "preview-${WORKERS_CI_BRANCH:-local}"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
